variants.name: 01-soft-enamel
variants.title: Soft enamel
variants.details: Design direction A — SOFT ENAMEL TILES AND CARD CARTRIDGES. Golden tiles have generous softly rounded corners, wide convex golden bevels and smooth satin enamel sides; dark amber face is visibly recessed with a fine continuous inner seam. The score numerals look beautifully printed, not glowing. Rear history units become rounded navy cartridge trays containing fifteen cobalt cards with rounded top corners and softly chamfered edges. The cards look like solid laminated data cards, not metal cooling fins. Blue satin surfaces, bright cool edge highlights and deep navy separations. Dark label plaque integrates into the front rail of each cartridge. Premium tactile desktop-object aesthetic, cheerful and approachable, sculpted but clean.

variants.name: 02-precision-hardware
variants.title: Precision hardware
variants.details: Design direction B — PRECISION-MACHINED MODULES. Golden score modules have sharply controlled broad 45-degree chamfers, brushed anodized gold sidewalls, a recessed dark amber enamel face, and a hairline dark reveal around the inset. Keep the shape clean and substantial, with soft enough corners to feel touchable. Histories are navy open-top cassettes with fifteen solid cobalt cards, each having one small symmetrical shoulder chamfer and a lighter blue layered edge. Flush integrated navy nameplate, precise tight gaps and a thin perimeter rim. Restrained microtexture on the sides only; face printing perfectly crisp. Refined industrial product photography, convincing thickness and elegant manufacturing detail. No screws or connectors.

variants.name: 03-playful-soft-touch
variants.title: Playful soft-touch
variants.details: Design direction C — PLAYFUL SOFT-TOUCH CARTRIDGES. Use the most sculptural, rounded silhouettes of the three directions. Golden score tiles resemble chunky premium soft-touch keycaps with pillowy rounded gold shells and broad dark amber inset faces, a substantial curved lip framing each face, ivory score labels and numerals. Gently bowed golden sidewalls catch large soft highlights. History cartridges have a thick rounded dark navy cradle holding fifteen cobalt blue cards with smooth pill-like rounded top edges and deep narrow separations; each card is identical and fully retained, tightly packed without empty slots. The dark inset history label is a rounded rectangle integrated into the cradle. Rich satin polymer / ceramic tactility, engaging collectible-object quality, no childish decorations or faces. Maintain the exact mature Retro Sunset palette and informational clarity.
